:::{#def-folds}
#### Folds

A division of observations $1, \ldots, n$ into $k$ **folds**
is a partition of $\set{1, \ldots, n}$ into $k$ nonempty, disjoint subsets
$\fold{1}, \ldots, \fold{k}$,
with $\foldsize{j}$ observations in fold $\fold{j}$,
so that $\foldsize{1} + \cdots + \foldsize{k} = n$.
The **fold assignment** $\foldof{i}$ of observation $i$
is the index of the fold that contains it:

$$
i \in \fold{\foldof{i}}.
$$ {#eq-fold-assignment}

:::
